# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

# Lactalis, Notre raison d'agir : Nourrir l'avenir

Le lait est une matière première extraordinaire, consommée partout dans le monde, valorisée sous des
formes multiples et des variétés infinies : beurres, crèmes, fromages, yaourts, etc. Notre métier
depuis 1933, c’est de donner vie au lait, d’en révéler toutes les saveurs, tous les bienfaits,
toutes les possibilités, pour satisfaire quotidiennement des consommateurs du monde entier qui
aiment des produits sains, naturels et gourmands.

# Elevating Ingredients. Activating Health.

###### [Get In Touch][48]
* #### Certified ingredients
  
  From grass fed, to kosher and halal - Actus Nutrition has ingredients to meets the needs of
  everyone.
* #### Customizable Formulations
  
  Our world-class research & development team bring expertise in formulations and flavoring to help
  you develop the perfect products.
* #### Private Label Partner
  
  Actus Nutrition offers a range of private label solutions for the sports nutrition, healthy
  snacking and breakfast cereal markets.
* #### Globally Trusted
  
  Actus Nutrition exports to 45+ countries, work with the leaders who can ensure your products
  arrive on time and on budget.

###### [About Us][49]

## **Elevating** Ingredients

As an early pioneer in upcycling “waste” whey into protein, Actus Nutrition has been manufacturing
high quality ingredients for more than 75+ years. Today, Actus is a top manufacturer of whey
proteins, milk proteins, casein and caseinate products. In addition to offering core ingredients
found in best-selling products across the grocery store, Actus offers a wide range of custom
ingredients catering to categories from infant nutrition to geriatric nutrition products.  

[Person meditating on a yoga mat at home]

## Activating **Health**

 Whether your customers are elite athletes, busy parents or those who need the best nutrition, Actus
offers ingredients and private label options for a wide range of food manufacturers. Modern
consumers want more functional benefits from their products – Actus Nutrition can help your products
stand out on grocery store shelves.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them.

American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

call home.

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Baltmilk?
Baltmilk is a modern dairy ingredients manufacturer based in Lithuania. We are a brand of Pienas LT
– the largest vertically integrated dairy cooperative in the Baltic States, uniting over 350 farms
with 35,000 cows.
What types of dairy ingredients do you offer?
Our product range includes:
• Milk protein concentrates (MPC85, MPC70, Micellar casein, NWPI90)
• Milk permeate powder (MPP85)
• Functional blends – tailored to customer needs
• 40% cream (bulk), approximately 25 tons per truck – mainly used for industrial applications such
as sweet cream or lactic butter, and anhydrous milk fat production.
What are the main applications of your products?
Our high-concentration milk protein ingredients are used in yogurts, ice cream, bakery and
confectionery, processed and analogue cheese, cream cheese, white brine cheese, beverages, coffee
creamers, puddings, protein bars, desserts and clinical nutrition.
Do you offer lactose-free, organic, or clean-label options?
Yes. We develop solutions including lactose-free, organic, and clean-label formulations depending on
customer needs.

We control the full supply chain – from cow to final product. Most of our ingredients are sourced
from our own cooperative farms, where cows graze in natural meadows. All our products are
hormone-free, antibiotic-free, GMO-free, and fully traceable. Functional blends may also include
selected ingredients from certified external sources.

All milk is tested in our laboratory before processing. Each production batch is fully traceable and

and are members of SEDEX, ensuring responsible and ethical production practices.
Are your products free from GMOs and antibiotics?
Yes. All our dairy ingredients are free from GMOs, antibiotics and hormones.
Do you use sustainable practices?
Yes. We use green energy (including solar power), recycle water, and optimize milk logistics to

What is your daily milk processing capacity?
We process up to 700 tons of milk daily, with over 95% sourced directly from cooperative members.

Today we export our products to over 40 countries. Key markets include Europe, Asia, the Middle East

What are the main applications of your products?
Our high-concentration milk protein ingredients are used in yogurts, ice cream, bakery and

selected ingredients from certified external sources.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

## About Us

Great Ultrafiltration Systems, Take Challenge IM
Pioneer of full-automatic ultrafiltration system
Challenge IM focuses on developing, manufacturing, selling, and servicing membrane filtration
systems for the biopharmaceutical industry. It has diversified its product lines to support
laboratory, pilot, and large-scale production, offering commercial and customized solutions that
meet customer and market needs. Its fully automated, unattended tangential flow filtration system
fills a significant gap in both domestic and international markets, driving global technological
innovation. These products are now widely used across various biopharmaceutical sectors, including
antibodies, vaccines, nucleic acid drugs, cell therapy, and gene therapy.

## Evaporators, Spray Dryers, Powder Handling & more

Dahmes provides advanced, custom evaporating and drying systems, and other industrial processes.
Since 1995, we have pioneered new process technologies, always aiming to serve our customers and
create solutions to their challenges.

### Evaporating & Drying Systems

Dahmes specializes in the design and manufacturing of advanced evaporating systems, drying systems,
and other process components for removing water and preserving product for food and other
industries. We understand how important project execution is – you don’t have time to shut down, so
we work with you to figure out how to achieve your optimum results.

more effective and more efficient.

experiment to find the right process for your product, your facility, your need. The R&D Center is
where we prove out a process, and work out the kinks before we create a system on site for our
customers that best suits their needs.

## Yeni ürünümüz, Enka Labne

Sofraların vazgeçilmezi olan, yediden yetmişe her yaştan tüketici tarafından tercih edilen labne
peyniri, zengin kalsiyum ve protein içeriği sayesinde besleyici bir peynirdir.

## 15.000’i aşkın üreticiden, sabah ve akşam olmak üzere günde iki kez veteriner kontrolünde
## toplanan sütlerimiz.

Ambalajımızı kolay katlanabilir ve tamamen boşaltılabilir hale getirirsek, her ürün ve durum için
doğru boyutta olursak, daha az yiyecek israfına neden olur..

# Online Etymology Dictionary

This is a map of the wheel-ruts of modern English. [Etymologies][5] are not definitions; they are
explanations of what words meant and how they sounded 600 or 2,000 years ago.

The Online Etymology Dictionary was created in 2001 by Douglas Harper, who continues it; the
etymonline domain name dates from 2003. Talia Felix, an independent researcher, has been associate
editor since 2021.

Etymonline aims to weave together words and the past, answer common questions, and sow seeds of
[serendipity][6]. Print sources used in this compilation are listed [here][7]. The user's manual is
[here][8].

This is a map of the wheel-ruts of modern English. [Etymologies][5] are not definitions; they are
explanations of what words meant and how they sounded 600 or 2,000 years ago.

The Online Etymology Dictionary was created in 2001 by Douglas Harper, who continues it; the
etymonline domain name dates from 2003. Talia Felix, an independent researcher, has been associate
editor since 2021.

Etymonline aims to weave together words and the past, answer common questions, and sow seeds of
[serendipity][6]. Print sources used in this compilation are listed [here][7]. The user's manual is
[here][8].

you**. For you who buy dairy ingredients, we know exactly what your company needs: the right product

approach guarantees freshness, quality, and consistency, while our sustainable practices benefit
both our customers and the environment.

our community and leaving a positive footprint on the world

## Making better food possible

Idaho Milk Products is committed to crafting the world's finest dairy ingredients. Our integrated
approach guarantees freshness, quality, and consistency, while our sustainable practices benefit
both our customers and the environment.

scale. ][Small pile of chocolate powder next to a glass container filled with the same powder and a
metal spoon resting inside.][Photo of the plant and the front sign ]

Sustainability isn't just a goal; it's one of our guiding principles. We're dedicated to uplifting
our community and leaving a positive footprint on the world

[
Sustainable Business

[A picture of two tractors harvesting corn. ]

### Global leader in food innovation

We're pushing the boundaries of dairy innovation. Our world-class scientists at the Milk Innovation
Center work with customers to turn food concepts into reality.

Milk Innovation

[Packaging part of the plant with an automated machine. ]

The Wonder of Living Light

## The World’s First Naturally Glowing Plants

Light Bio brings the hidden wonders of the world into your hands with the world’s first naturally
glowing plants! Inspired by the bioluminescence found in our oceans and forests, these extraordinary
plants glow with their own living energy. No batteries, wires, or sprays.

Light Bio’s bioluminescent petunias offer a new way to witness the vitality of nature! During the
day, our petunias harvest and store energy through photosynthesis. At night, the plants convert that
stored energy into a visible soft, steady glow that permeates the entire plant, from its brightest
new blooms to every leaf and stem.

[Before Image]
[After Image]

## The Magic is Resting Until Spring 2027 

Our 2026 season has officially come to a close. While our bioluminescent plants are back in the
greenhouse, the wonder doesn't stop here.

Become a Glow-Getter to receive our newsletters and join the waitlist! We'll be sharing glowing
stories, plant care tips, exclusive behind-the-scenes looks at our biotech greenhouse, and official
updates on our Spring 2027 return.

An NSN is a unique 13-character identifier used by NATO Countries to classify and track items in
their inventory.

**NSN Lookup** tools also known as National Stock Number Lookup or NATO Stock Number Lookup tools
allow users to search for specific items by entering the NSN, partial NSN or NIIN. The tools provide
detailed information about items, including description, characteristics, technical specifications,
and pricing and availability.
**NSN Lookup** tools facilitate logistics, procurement, and supply chain management for military
organizations and government agencies. They help streamline the process of identifying and procuring
the correct items by providing standardized information and ensuring interoperability among
different entities.

### [NSN Lookup Tool] NSN Lookup a tool used to search and retrieve information about items that
### have been assigned a NATO Stock Number (NSN)

An NSN is a unique 13-character identifier used by NATO Countries to classify and track items in
their inventory.

**NSN Lookup** tools also known as National Stock Number Lookup or NATO Stock Number Lookup tools
allow users to search for specific items by entering the NSN, partial NSN or NIIN. The tools provide
detailed information about items, including description, characteristics, technical specifications,
and pricing and availability.
**NSN Lookup** tools facilitate logistics, procurement, and supply chain management for military
organizations and government agencies. They help streamline the process of identifying and procuring
the correct items by providing standardized information and ensuring interoperability among
different entities.

# Finest Food Ingredients for
# 20+ Industries

[Ram Ratan Kashi Ram][15] (RRKR) is a sought-after supplier of high-quality dairy and [plant-based
ingredients][16] in India and across the globe. Serving diverse industries such as food and
beverage, pharmaceuticals, and sports nutrition, we offer a wide range of products including milk
powders, whey proteins, cocoa powder, xanthan gum, ghee, butter, and more. As a leading global
supplier with the capacity to fulfill large orders, we enhance the flavor, texture, and nutritional
value of your products.

drinks.

## Shawmut makes materials.

We make next-generation textiles and coated fabrics engineered to solve hard problems and help you
achieve your product vision. 

The foundation of our success is expertise across a broad range of material technologies that we
combine in innovative ways to create flexible materials with the right properties to meet your
unique needs.

## Materials that perform.

Shawmut materials perform in some of the toughest applications in some of the world’s most demanding
industries.

Our materials experience across industries has taught us how to understand your performance
challenges and design a material that will excel for your applications.

downstream recycling programs.

your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.
